title: Syrian Lamb Roast
description: A traditional Syrian dish featuring lamb roast wrapped in puff pastry, flavored with warmly spiced ingredients, perfect for special occasions, this sugar-free-friendly recipe is a must try for those looking for a cultured and shattering one-pot meal.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200 degrees Celsius.
Season the lamb shoulder with salt, black pepper, cumin, coriander, and cinnamon.
Heat the olive oil in a large oven-safe pot over medium heat.
Sear the lamb shoulder until browned on all sides, then set aside.
Add the chopped onion to the pot and cook until softened, then add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the lamb shoulder back to the pot and wrap with puff pastry, brushing the edges with a little water to seal.
Place the pot in the preheated oven and roast for 2.5 hours, or until the lamb is tender and the pastry is golden brown.
Remove the pot from the oven and let it rest for 10 minutes before slicing and serving.
Serve the Syrian lamb roast hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
